tasks.label: Validate session routing structure
args: const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),files=['desktop-agent/assets/session.html','desktop-agent/assets/controller_session.html','desktop-agent/assets/remote_session.html'];for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi))new Function(m[1]);console.log(f+' scripts='+[...s.matchAll(/<script\b/gi)].length+' bytes='+Buffer.byteLength(s));}function route(file,search){let target='';const s=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');const code=s.match(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/i)[1];const location={search,href:'http://127.0.0.1/session.html'+search,hash:'#keep',replace:value=>target=value};vm.runInNewContext(code,{URL,URLSearchParams,window:{location}});return new URL(target);}for(const [query,expected] of [['?id=123&token=secret&integrated=1','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=A&mode=desktop','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=B&mode=desktop','remote_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret','remote_session.html']]){const url=route(files[0],query);if(!url.pathname.endsWith('/'+expected)||url.searchParams.get('id')!=='123'||url.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret')throw Error('Router failure for '+query);console.log('route '+query+' -> '+url.pathname+url.search);}const remote=route(files[2],'?id=123&token=secret&layer=B');if(!remote.pathname.endsWith('/dashboard.html')||remote.searchParams.get('overlay')!=='1'||remote.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret')throw Error('Remote entry did not preserve params');const c=fs.readFileSync(files[1],'utf8');if(!c.includes('id="viewerHeader"')||c.includes('id="floatingControls"')||c.includes('optionsToggleBtn'))throw Error('Controller UI boundary failure');console.log('Controller horizontal header present; B toolbar markup absent.');

tasks.label: Confirm split file content
args: const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['desktop-agent/assets/controller_session.html','desktop-agent/assets/dashboard.html']){const a=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);console.log('\n'+p+' lines='+a.length+' bytes='+Buffer.byteLength(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')));for(let i=800;i<Math.min(830,a.length);i++)if(/overlay|SESSION_PARAMS|function startConnection|function startWebStream|const BACKEND|CONFIG/.test(a[i]))console.log((i+1)+': '+a[i].trim());}

tasks.label: Test routes and UI boundaries
args: const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),files=['desktop-agent/assets/session.html','desktop-agent/assets/controller_session.html','desktop-agent/assets/remote_session.html'];for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi))new Function(m[1]);}function route(f,search){let out='';const code=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').match(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/i)[1];vm.runInNewContext(code,{URL,URLSearchParams,window:{location:{search,href:'http://host/session.html'+search,hash:'#keep',replace:x=>out=x}}});return new URL(out);}for(const [q,p] of [['?id=123&token=secret&integrated=1','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=A','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=B','remote_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret','remote_session.html']]){const u=route(files[0],q);if(!u.pathname.endsWith(p)||u.searchParams.get('id')!=='123'||u.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret')throw Error('router failed '+q);}const b=route(files[2],'?id=123&token=secret&layer=B');if(!b.pathname.endsWith('dashboard.html')||b.searchParams.get('overlay')!=='1'||b.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret')throw Error('remote entry params failed');const c=fs.readFileSync(files[1],'utf8');if(!c.includes('viewerHeader')||c.includes('optionsToggleBtn'))throw Error('controller UI boundary failed');console.log('PASS: all inline scripts parse; A/B routes and parameters preserved; remote entry sets overlay; A header present and B toolbar markup absent.');

args: const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),files=['desktop-agent/assets/session.html','desktop-agent/assets/controller_session.html','desktop-agent/assets/remote_session.html'];for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi))new Function(m[1]);}function run(f,q){let result='';const code=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').match(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/i)[1];vm.runInNewContext(code,{URL,URLSearchParams,window:{location:{search:q,href:'https://unit.test/session.html'+q,hash:'#fragment',replace:x=>result=x}}});return new URL(result);}for(const [q,p] of [['?id=123&token=secret&integrated=1','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=A','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=B','remote_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret','remote_session.html']]){const u=run(files[0],q);if(!u.pathname.endsWith(p)||u.searchParams.get('id')!=='123'||u.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret'||u.hash!=='#fragment')throw Error('route or parameter mismatch '+q);}const remote=run(files[2],'?id=123&token=secret&layer=B');if(!remote.pathname.endsWith('dashboard.html')||remote.searchParams.get('overlay')!=='1')throw Error('remote dashboard overlay route failed');const c=fs.readFileSync(files[1],'utf8');if(!c.includes('viewerHeader')||c.includes('floatingControls')||c.includes('optionsToggleBtn')||c.includes('startToolbarDrag'))throw Error('controller/remote UI separation failed');console.log('PASS: inline script syntax; layer/integrated routing; id/token/mode/hash preservation; B dashboard-overlay route; A header present and all B-toolbar DOM/drag code absent.');

tasks.label: Run router and HTML checks
args: const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),files=['desktop-agent/assets/session.html','desktop-agent/assets/controller_session.html','desktop-agent/assets/remote_session.html'];for(const f of files){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of s.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi))new Function(m[1]);}function run(f,q){let result='';const code=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').match(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/i)[1];vm.runInNewContext(code,{URL,URLSearchParams,window:{location:{search:q,href:'https://unit.test/session.html'+q,hash:'#fragment',replace:x=>result=x}}});return new URL(result);}for(const [q,p] of [['?id=123&token=secret&integrated=1','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=A','controller_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret&layer=B','remote_session.html'],['?id=123&token=secret','remote_session.html']]){const u=run(files[0],q);if(!u.pathname.endsWith(p)||u.searchParams.get('id')!=='123'||u.searchParams.get('token')!=='secret'||u.hash!=='#fragment')throw Error('router mismatch '+q);}const r=run(files[2],'?id=123&token=secret&layer=B');if(!r.pathname.endsWith('dashboard.html')||r.searchParams.get('overlay')!=='1')throw Error('remote entry mismatch');const c=fs.readFileSync(files[1],'utf8');if(!c.includes('viewerHeader')||c.includes('optionsToggleBtn')||c.includes('startToolbarDrag')||c.includes('positionFloatingToolbar'))throw Error('controller toolbar separation mismatch');console.log('PASS: inline JavaScript syntax, A/B routing, preserved id/token/hash, existing B overlay entry, and A-only toolbar boundary.');

tasks.label: Stage final DeskStream build
args: $root='C:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share'; $release='C:\cargo-target\deskstream\release\DeskStream.exe'; $staged=Join-Path $root 'DESKSTREAM\DeskStream.exe'; $verifier=Join-Path $root 'scripts\verify-release-signature.ps1'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $release)){throw 'Release executable missing; staging aborted'}; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $verifier)){throw 'Production signature verifier missing; staging aborted'}; & $verifier -ExePath $release; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Release signature verification failed; staging aborted'}; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $release -Destination $staged -Force; $releaseHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $release -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $stagedHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $staged -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; if($releaseHash -ne $stagedHash){throw 'Staged executable hash mismatch'}; & $verifier -ExePath $staged; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Staged signature verification failed'}; Write-Output "Release SHA256: $releaseHash"; Write-Output "Staging SHA256: $stagedHash"; Write-Output 'Signature and hash verification passed.'
